title: Telomere Maintenance and Gene Amplification in Saccharomyces Genome Database
summary: This cluster revolves around telomere maintenance and gene amplification in the organism FY4. Telomere is recognized by exonucleases and involved in mmBIR, which is also required by yku70. Telomerase, mutated by ARS228, is involved in DNA repair. Gene amplification, involving SUL1, amplifies chr II, which contains the URA3 gene and has an amplicon junction with yku70Δ. SUL1 is amplified by Rad52, pol32, and yku70, and amplifies chr II. Y' is amplified by yku70 and has homology with ITS, which is involved in mmBIR. The Saccharomyces Genome Database hosts SGD, which has a chromosome from chr VIII.
